newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Two dead in Slovak VSZ steel accident.
newsitem.headline: Two dead in Slovak VSZ steel accident.

text.p: Two workers were killed and two others seriously injured on Monday when they were struck by molten steel spilled from a pan at the eastern Slovak steel works VSZ a.s., a company spokesman said.
"One died immediately and the second died shortly after in hospital from serious burns," VSZ spokesman Jozef Marko told Reuters.
Marko could not confirm unofficial reports that a third worker had also died in hospital, but said one of the injured was in very critical condition.

In October 1995, 11 people were killed and at least 240 injured at the steel works after an explosion and subsequent gas leak. The accident occured on a Friday morning but was not publicly announced until the next day.
Eight leading technicians, including two senior managers, were sacked as a result of the explosion later in October.
VSZ is Slovakia's largest steel maker, employing some 25,000 workers.
